walkthrough: Goal: put part of a drawing somewhere else, bigger or smaller, turned or mirrored, without redrawing it, and find it there tomorrow.

Entry: on a canvas with a few lines, tap Transform, the arrow after Selection in the left island (Procreate's place). It takes the ink ring, the Brush button loses its ring, and the layer's content is framed: a thin ink line on a paper line around exactly what is painted, a round handle at each corner and one above the top edge on a short stem. The frame fades in. A bar in the middle of the top band offers Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Rotate 45° and Reset (grey: nothing moved yet).

Move: drag inside the frame with the pen (or one finger): the drawing follows the pen exactly, frame and all. Scale: drag a corner: the drawing grows or shrinks evenly about the opposite corner. Turn: drag the handle above the frame round its centre; crossing straight down never jumps the long way round. Two fingers starting inside the frame move, pinch and twist it together; fingers outside it still move the view.

Taps: Flip Horizontal and Flip Vertical mirror the drawing about the frame's centre, Rotate 45° turns it an eighth clockwise. While the tool is on, undo and redo (side bar or two- and three-finger taps) step through these moves and taps; Reset puts everything back where it was.

Done: tap Transform again, or choose Brush, Eraser, the eyedropper, Selection or any other edit: the drawing stays where it shows, pixel for pixel what the frame showed, as one step of the drawing; one undo takes the whole transform back, redo brings it again. Nothing moved: nothing is recorded.
Selection: with a selection, Transform lifts only what is painted inside it; the rest of the layer stays. Once committed nothing is selected any more, since what was selected moved.
Failure: a hidden or locked layer, or nothing painted there, says so in a pill with OK, and the tool stays off. Reopen after the system closed the app: the moved drawing is where it was left.
Not here: Freeform, Distort, Warp, snapping, Fit to screen, interpolation choices. Since S31 the content is not resampled: it is drawn again where it moved (s31-transform-record).
